description: This file defines a collection of Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to order functionalities in a grocery backend application. It includes record classes for order item responses, order responses, and updating order status requests.

classes.name: OrderItemResponse
classes.description: A DTO representing an individual item within an order, including id, productId, name snapshot, unit price, and quantity.

classes.name: OrderResponse
classes.description: A DTO representing an order, containing its id, list of items, total price, status, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: UpdateOrderStatusRequest
classes.description: A DTO used for requests to update the status of an order, requiring a non-null status.

methods.name: OrderItemResponse
methods.description: Constructor for creating an OrderItemResponse record instance.

methods.name: OrderResponse
methods.description: Constructor for creating an OrderResponse record instance.

methods.name: UpdateOrderStatusRequest
methods.description: Constructor for creating an UpdateOrderStatusRequest record instance.
